competences: The learner identifies familiar means of road transport.
The learner names the two types of roads in the source.
languageCompetence: Pronounces, reads, spells and writes: road, tarmac, murram, bus, car, lorry, pedestrian.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to name four means of road transport.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to identify drivers, passengers and pedestrians.
priorKnowledge: The previous week introduced road transport alongside water, railway and air transport; this lesson focuses on familiar means used on roads.
materials: Wall chart showing buses, cars, lorries and bicycles
Picture and word cards for drivers, passengers, pedestrians and cyclists
references: P I Literacy Scheme OF Work Term III
P I Literacy Lesson Notes Term III

steps.content: Transport pictures and the starter question: __________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays wall chart showing buses, cars, lorries and bicycles and asks: "__________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land." Learners first identify familiar pictures; the teacher connects their responses to road transport.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners look at the transport pictures, identify familiar words, and give oral responses to the starter question before copying any notes.

steps.content: Meaning of road transport: Road transport is the movement of people and goods on land.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher points to the relevant transport pictures and writes these points on the board: Road transport is the movement of people and goods on land. Using guided discussion, the teacher asks: "__________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land." and checks that learners identify the corresponding pictures or words.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify the pictures and words for meaning of road transport, answer the quoted question, and copy the short points into their books.

steps.content: Types of roads: Tarmac roads Murram roads
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher points to the relevant transport pictures and writes these points on the board: Tarmac roads Murram roads Using guided discussion, the teacher asks: "Write four means of road transport." and checks that learners identify the corresponding pictures or words.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify the pictures and words for types of roads, answer the quoted question, and copy the short points into their books.

steps.content: Means of road transport: Buses Cars Lorries Bicycles Motorcycles
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher points to the relevant transport pictures and writes these points on the board: Buses Cars Lorries Bicycles Motorcycles Using guided discussion, the teacher asks: "Draw these means of road transport: bus and car." and checks that learners identify the corresponding pictures or words.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify the pictures and words for means of road transport, answer the quoted question, and copy the short points into their books.

steps.stage: Development: People who use road transport
steps.content: People who use road transport: Drivers Passengers Pedestrians Cyclists
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher points to the relevant transport pictures and writes these points on the board: Drivers Passengers Pedestrians Cyclists Using guided discussion, the teacher asks: "Draw these means of road transport: bus and car." and checks that learners identify the corresponding pictures or words.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify the pictures and words for people who use road transport, answer the quoted question, and copy the short points into their books.

steps.content: 1. __________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land. 2. Write four means of road transport. 3. Draw these means of road transport: bus and car.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher sets the sourced exercise: "__________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land." "Write four means of road transport." "Draw these means of road transport: bus and car." The teacher reads each item clearly, checks individual answers, and uses the transport chart to correct mistaken identifications.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer the exercise questions in their books, complete any specified matching or drawing, and correct their responses with the teacher.

source.quote: transport is the movement of people and goods on land

steps.content: Key points: Road transport is the movement of people and goods on land.; Tarmac roads Murram roads; Buses Cars Lorries Bicycles Motorcycles; Drivers Passengers Pedestrians Cyclists
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher checks the lesson objectives using these exercise items: "__________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land." "Write four means of road transport." "Draw these means of road transport: bus and car." The teacher confirms correct answers against the board notes and identifies learners needing further picture-supported practice.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners give short oral answers, compare them with the transport pictures and board notes, and correct any remaining errors in their books.

assessment: Check the written exercise and oral responses: __________ transport is the movement of people and goods on land. Write four means of road transport. Draw these means of road transport: bus and car. Mark against the source-based answers and revisit incorrect identifications using the transport chart.
homework: Complete or correct this sourced exercise item in your book: Draw these means of road transport: bus and car.
